source=fresh Developer scratch orgs, one per capture run, deleted after the run and verified gone
payloads=OBS lines from the USER_DEBUG log, the uncaught exception (the row's error column) or the test failure message; no ids in any payload
repeats=two clean runs; rows identical
raw_runs=review13/out/20261117T183920Z and 20261117T184210Z (gk_*, gw_*); review14/out/20261117T222748Z and 20261117T222953Z (dc_*) (capture cache, not committed)
shapes=on a typed Map<String,Schema.SObjectType> holder of Schema.getGlobalDescribe(): get, containsKey and size after keySet().remove; keySet().removeAll and retainAll; saved key sets taken before the write; local, static, field and parameter aliases writing through their own key sets; a second holder taken before the write; direct put, putAll, remove (present, missing, upper-case key, inside try/catch) and clear, on the holder and chained on Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); remove on a clone; the key-set steps through a class method (anonymous) and inside an @IsTest method; deepClone of the global describe (typed holder and chained, alone and followed by put, remove or clear) and of Map<String,Integer>, Map<String,Object>, Map<String,List<Account>>, Map<String,SObject> and Map<Id,Account>
notes=put, putAll and remove on the global describe map raise the uncatchable System.FinalException: Collection is read-only, typed or chained, whatever the key; clear succeeds and empties that holder only, chained clear leaves a fresh getGlobalDescribe() unchanged. A key-set remove, removeAll, retainAll or clear writes through to the holder and every alias of it (get null, containsKey false for either case of the name), and saved key sets of the holder see the write; a second holder and a fresh getGlobalDescribe() are unchanged. A clone is writable. deepClone compiles only on a map whose values are SObjects: the global describe, Map<String,Integer>, Map<String,Object> and Map<String,List<Account>> are refused at compile with "Operation only applies to SObject value map types: <type>" (compiled=false rows), while Map<String,SObject> and Map<Id,Account> compile and run.
limits=counts are written as differences, so the environment's describe size does not appear. Namespaced orgs were not captured.
